Bihar 2 Year BEd Admission Result 2026 - Complete Details

Bihar 2 Year BEd Admission Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. The last date to apply is 18/05/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 27/04/2026
  • Last Date : 18/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 18/05/2026
  • Correction Date : 22-23 May 2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : 01/06/2026
  • Exam Date : 07/06/2026
  • Result Declare Date : 19/06/2026
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • Download Admit Card Notice : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 27/04/2026
  • Last Date : 18/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 18/05/2026
  • Late Fees for Registration : 21/05/2026
  • General : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC /ST : Rs. 500/-
  • Bachelor Degree in Education (B.Ed) 2 Year Course.Shiksha Shastri Programme : Bachelor Degree with Minimum 50% Marks in Any Recognized University in India.For BE / B.Tech Candidates 55% Marks Required.More Details Read the Notification.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
